subtitle.zh: 无人值守，不代表已经停机。
subtitle.en: An empty station can still be alive.

briefing.zh: 空间站失去语音联系，调查局据此宣布它已停用。找到两份相互印证的材料，推翻初判。
briefing.en: The bureau declared Station 17 offline after losing voice contact. Find two corroborating exhibits to overturn the finding.

objective.zh: 证明 9 月 27 日 20:00 后核心系统仍在运行。
objective.en: Establish essential system activity after 20:00 on September 27.

defense.zh: 人员已经撤离。即使有热量，也可能只是停机后的余温。
defense.en: The crew left. Any warmth may be residual heat after shutdown.

hint.zh: 近期设备日志是起点，再找另一种来源；让反驳对应你的第二份证据。
hint.en: Start with recent machine data, add another source, and match the rebuttal to that source.

facts.power: Do the readings show repeated active air circulation after 20:00 on September 27, 2026?
facts.maintained: Does a completed maintenance record explicitly say air circulation returned to active service that evening?
facts.warm: Does the image show warm radiator readings captured at 21:11 on September 27, 2026?

summary.zh: 每十分钟回传一次的设备日志。
summary.en: Machine readings repeated every ten minutes.

body.en: On September 27, 2026 at 20:56, 21:06 and 21:16 UTC+8, draw was 4.8, 4.8 and 4.7 kW; air circulation remained active.

summary.zh: 一张在失联之后关闭的工单。
summary.en: A ticket closed after contact was lost.

body.zh: 9 月 27 日 21:08，无人值守的空气循环维护完成，系统恢复运行。工单 ST17-MNT-0927。
body.en: At 21:08 UTC+8 on September 27, 2026, uncrewed air-circulation maintenance was completed and the system returned to active service. ST17-MNT-0927.

summary.zh: 两个散热区仍呈暖色。
summary.en: Two radiator zones still register warmth.

body.zh: 扫描显示 21:11 的散热区温度；热量本身不能区分运行和余温。
body.en: Inspect the image's timestamp and radiator temperatures. Warmth alone cannot distinguish operation from residual heat.

summary.zh: 人员撤离记录有正式盖章。
summary.en: An official record of the crew leaving.

body.zh: 人员在 9 月 22 日离站。此记录没有设备停机指令。
body.en: The crew left on September 22. This record contains no equipment shutdown order.

summary.zh: 照片上的空间站灯火通明。
summary.en: A brilliantly lit station in the archive.

body.zh: 宣传照拍摄于 2024 年，不能证明当前运行状态。
body.en: This publicity image was captured in 2024 and says nothing about current operation.

detail.zh: 让供电记录与热像互证。
detail.en: Corroborate the scan with repeated power readings.

manifest.title: Silent Orbit
manifest.objective: Establish essential system activity after 20:00 on September 27.

facts.power: Do the readings show repeated active air circulation after 20:00 on September 27, 2026?
facts.maintained: Does a completed maintenance record explicitly say air circulation returned to active service that evening?
facts.warm: Does the image show warm radiator readings captured at 21:11 on September 27, 2026?

evidence.content: On September 27, 2026 at 20:56, 21:06 and 21:16 UTC+8, draw was 4.8, 4.8 and 4.7 kW; air circulation remained active.
At 21:08 UTC+8 on September 27, 2026, uncrewed air-circulation maintenance was completed and the system returned to active service. ST17-MNT-0927.
Inspect the image's timestamp and radiator temperatures. Warmth alone cannot distinguish operation from residual heat.
The crew left on September 22. This record contains no equipment shutdown order.
This publicity image was captured in 2024 and says nothing about current operation.

subtitle.zh: 迟到的是货物，还是记录？
subtitle.en: Was the cargo late—or just its paperwork?

briefing.zh: 一艘运输艇被指控错过午夜截止时间。航拍、登记和船钟采用了不同的时间口径。还原经过，再提交申诉。
briefing.en: A cargo shuttle allegedly missed a midnight deadline. The camera, registry and ship clock use different time references. Reconstruct the events.

objective.zh: 证明货物在当地时间 00:00 前抵港，并排好事件顺序。
objective.en: Show arrival before local midnight and put the events in order.

defense.zh: 入库单写着 00:12，所以这批货至少迟到了十二分钟。
defense.en: The warehouse receipt says 00:12. The cargo was at least twelve minutes late.

hint.zh: 航拍使用 UTC，港口使用 UTC+8；到港和入库不是同一个事件。
hint.en: The camera uses UTC; the port uses UTC+8. Docking and filing are different events.

facts.arrival: Does the source record physical arrival on September 27 at 15:50 UTC or 23:50 UTC+8?
facts.offset: Does the source establish that local port time is UTC+8?
facts.filing: Does the source distinguish filing at 00:12 on September 28 from physical docking earlier?
facts.dispatch: Does the source record departure at 23:40 local time on September 27?

summary.zh: 相机时间：15:50 UTC。
summary.en: Camera time: 15:50 UTC.

body.zh: 9 月 27 日 15:50 UTC，运输艇实体靠上泊位；此前的镜头为空泊位。
body.en: At 15:50 UTC on September 27, 2026, the cargo shuttle physically docked. The earlier frame shows an empty berth.

summary.zh: 船钟和港口钟的换算口径。
summary.en: The offset between ship and port clocks.

body.zh: 港口时间采用 UTC+8；相机采用 UTC。相机 15:50 对应港口同日 23:50。
body.en: The port uses UTC+8; the camera uses UTC. Camera time 15:50 equals 23:50 at the port on the same date.

summary.zh: 一个很醒目的 00:12 印章。
summary.en: A conspicuous 00:12 stamp.

body.zh: 9 月 28 日 00:12 是入库文书录入时间。附注：实体靠泊已于上一日 23:50 完成。
body.en: 00:12 on September 28 is the administrative filing time. Note: physical docking completed at 23:50 on the preceding day.

summary.zh: 起飞事件是时间线的锚点。
summary.en: Departure anchors the event sequence.

body.zh: 9 月 27 日当地时间 23:40 离开出发站。
body.en: The shuttle departed at 23:40 local time on September 27, 2026.

summary.zh: 审计记录同时说明时区与到港。
summary.en: The auditor records both time base and arrival.

body.zh: 审计采用 UTC+8。实际靠泊时间为 9 月 27 日 23:50。00:12 只是入库文书的录入时间。
body.en: This audit uses UTC+8. Physical docking occurred at 23:50 on September 27; 00:12 on September 28 was paperwork filing only.

summary.zh: “我记得肯定过了十二点”。
summary.en: I remember it was definitely after midnight.

body.zh: 转述者没有说明是在看货物到港还是文书登记，也没有可靠时间记录。
body.en: The witness does not distinguish docking from filing and has no reliable timestamp.

manifest.title: Midnight Cargo
manifest.objective: Show arrival before local midnight and put the events in order.

facts.arrival: Does the source record physical arrival on September 27 at 15:50 UTC or 23:50 UTC+8?
facts.offset: Does the source establish that local port time is UTC+8?
facts.filing: Does the source distinguish filing at 00:12 on September 28 from physical docking earlier?
facts.dispatch: Does the source record departure at 23:40 local time on September 27?

evidence.content: At 15:50 UTC on September 27, 2026, the cargo shuttle physically docked. The earlier frame shows an empty berth.
The port uses UTC+8; the camera uses UTC. Camera time 15:50 equals 23:50 at the port on the same date.
00:12 on September 28 is the administrative filing time. Note: physical docking completed at 23:50 on the preceding day.
The shuttle departed at 23:40 local time on September 27, 2026.
This audit uses UTC+8. Physical docking occurred at 23:50 on September 27; 00:12 on September 28 was paperwork filing only.
The witness does not distinguish docking from filing and has no reliable timestamp.

subtitle.zh: 画面是真的，指控就成立吗？
subtitle.en: A real image can support the wrong claim.

briefing.zh: 一张检验截图被用来指控本批货物损坏。你需要指出图像里决定性的细节，并找到与之相符的档案。
briefing.en: An inspection frame is offered as proof that today's cargo was damaged. Pinpoint the decisive visual detail and corroborate it with a record.

objective.zh: 证明该图像不能作为当前 R71 货物的有效证据。
objective.en: Show that the frame is not valid evidence about the current R71 shipment.

defense.zh: 图像来自正式检验相机，外观也相似，因此足以证明这批货存在问题。
defense.en: The image came from an official inspection camera and the cargo looks similar. That should be enough.

hint.zh: 真图也可能指错对象或引用错日期；序列号和时间戳都能成为路线。
hint.en: A genuine image can depict the wrong item or date. Inspect both the serial and timestamp.

facts.serial17: Do the image pixels show the inspected object's serial as R17?
facts.old_date: Do the image pixels show capture date June 3, 2024?
facts.target71: Does the registry identify the disputed cargo as R71?
facts.current_date: Does the current case record identify the disputed shipment date as September 27, 2026?

summary.zh: 相似的货物，角落里有小字。
summary.en: A familiar object. Small details in its corners.

body.zh: 请查看图像中的序列号和拍摄日期，区分被拍摄物体与当前争议货物。
body.en: Read the visible serial and capture date in the image. Distinguish the photographed item from the disputed cargo.

summary.zh: 这一批货的唯一身份。
summary.en: The identity of the shipment under dispute.

body.zh: 当前争议货物序列号 R71，运输日期 2026 年 9 月 27 日。
body.en: The disputed shipment is serial R71, shipped on September 27, 2026.

summary.zh: 旧检验图像的归档日期。
summary.en: The archive date of older inspection frames.

body.zh: 编号 077 属于 2024 年 6 月 3 日检验批次。当前索赔属于 2026 年 9 月 27 日货运批次。
body.en: Frame 077 belongs to the June 3, 2024 inspection batch. The current claim concerns the September 27, 2026 shipment.

summary.zh: 两批货物都使用灰色标准箱。
summary.en: Both batches used standard gray cases.

body.zh: 标准包装外观相同，外观不能唯一识别货物。
body.en: Standard packaging looks the same and cannot identify a unique shipment.

summary.zh: 认证书能证明相机正常工作。
summary.en: The certificate says the camera worked.

body.zh: 相机于 2024 年通过校准；此证书没有说明图像中的货物是 R71。
body.en: The camera was calibrated in 2024. The certificate does not identify the photographed cargo as R71.

manifest.title: The Borrowed Frame
manifest.objective: Show that the frame is not valid evidence about the current R71 shipment.

facts.serial17: Do the image pixels show the inspected object's serial as R17?
facts.old_date: Do the image pixels show capture date June 3, 2024?
facts.target71: Does the registry identify the disputed cargo as R71?
facts.current_date: Does the current case record identify the disputed shipment date as September 27, 2026?

evidence.content: Read the visible serial and capture date in the image. Distinguish the photographed item from the disputed cargo.
The disputed shipment is serial R71, shipped on September 27, 2026.
Frame 077 belongs to the June 3, 2024 inspection batch. The current claim concerns the September 27, 2026 shipment.
Standard packaging looks the same and cannot identify a unique shipment.
The camera was calibrated in 2024. The certificate does not identify the photographed cargo as R71.

subtitle.zh: 三个声音，可能只有一个来源。
subtitle.en: Three voices may have only one source.

briefing.zh: 三家媒体同时报道燃料泄漏，港口即将封锁。追溯转载关系，找到真正独立的证据。
briefing.en: Three outlets report a fuel leak and the port is about to close. Trace the copied reports and find independent evidence.

objective.zh: 判断泄漏指控是否得到独立证据支持，推翻缺乏依据的封锁。
objective.en: Challenge the closure by checking whether independent evidence supports a leak.

defense.zh: 已经有三家媒体确认泄漏。报道数量本身就是相互印证。
defense.en: Three outlets have confirmed the leak. The number of reports itself is corroboration.

hint.zh: 看文章引用的原始通报。传感器和维修部门才是不同来源。
hint.en: Follow the reports back to the original bulletin. Sensors and maintenance are separate sources.

facts.normal: Does a direct gas sensor reading show 0.02 units, below the leak threshold of 0.10, in the disputed window?
facts.vent: Does a maintenance record identify the plume as a scheduled inert-gas vent rather than leaking fuel?
facts.retracted: Does the original bulletin explicitly retract the fuel-leak claim?
facts.copied: Does this report explicitly cite Bulletin B-19 rather than offer an independent observation?

summary.zh: 头条：燃料泄漏已确认。
summary.en: Headline: fuel leak confirmed.

body.zh: 报道引用通讯台通报 B-19；记者没有到现场，也没有独立观测。
body.en: This article cites communications bulletin B-19. Its reporter made no independent observation.

summary.zh: 第二家媒体也报道了同一警报。
summary.en: A second outlet repeats the alarm.

body.zh: 本文转载轨道日报，原始来源仍为 B-19，没有新增观测。
body.en: This article copies Orbital Daily, whose original source is B-19. It adds no independent observation.

summary.zh: 第三份报道让指控看起来更强。
summary.en: A third report makes the claim seem stronger.

body.zh: 航线新闻基于 B-19 整理消息，没有派驻记者。
body.en: Route News compiled this story from B-19 without an on-site reporter.

summary.zh: 原始读数有明确阈值。
summary.en: Raw readings include a published threshold.

body.zh: 争议时段现场读数 0.02，泄漏阈值 0.10。传感器未触发燃料泄漏。
body.en: During the disputed window, the direct gas sensor read 0.02 units against a fuel-leak threshold of 0.10. It did not detect a leak.

summary.zh: 白色气团可能另有来由。
summary.en: There may be another explanation for the plume.

body.zh: 当时正在进行已登记的惰性气体排放，并非燃料泄漏。维护部门独立于通讯台。
body.en: The plume came from a scheduled inert-gas vent, not leaking fuel. Maintenance is independent of the communications desk.

summary.zh: B-19 的编辑记录已更新。
summary.en: The edit history of B-19 has changed.

body.zh: 通讯台撤回 B-19 中的燃料泄漏指控；最初误将计划排气当成泄漏。
body.en: The communications desk retracts the fuel-leak claim in B-19. A scheduled vent was initially mistaken for a leak.

manifest.objective: Challenge the closure by checking whether independent evidence supports a leak.

facts.vent: Does a maintenance record identify the plume as a scheduled inert-gas vent rather than leaking fuel?
facts.retracted: Does the original bulletin explicitly retract the fuel-leak claim?
facts.copied: Does this report explicitly cite Bulletin B-19 rather than offer an independent observation?

evidence.content: This article cites communications bulletin B-19. Its reporter made no independent observation.
This article copies Orbital Daily, whose original source is B-19. It adds no independent observation.
Route News compiled this story from B-19 without an on-site reporter.
During the disputed window, the direct gas sensor read 0.02 units against a fuel-leak threshold of 0.10. It did not detect a leak.

subtitle.zh: 找到可行路线，也要付得起代价。
subtitle.en: A route needs proof—and enough power.

briefing.zh: 六名旅客等待转移，救援艇只剩五格可分配能源。北侧有碎片，南侧有逆流。用证据选择路线，再把能源分配到真正需要的位置。
briefing.en: Six travelers await transfer. The shuttle has five power cells: debris threatens the north route, currents slow the south. Prove a route works and power it correctly.

objective.zh: 以两种可行方案之一完成六人的撤离；总能源不能超过五格。
objective.en: Build either valid evacuation plan for all six travelers using at most five power cells.

defense.zh: 两侧通道都有风险。最安全的选择就是继续等待。
defense.en: Both corridors are risky. Waiting must be the safest choice.

hint.zh: 北线需要护盾 3＋引导 2；南线需要引擎 3＋引导 2。路线和反驳都要与所选证据一致。
hint.en: North needs shield 3 + guidance 2. South needs engine 3 + guidance 2. Match the evidence and argument to the chosen plan.

facts.north_safe: Does the visual corridor scan say NORTH can be traversed with shield at least 3 and guidance at least 2?
facts.south_safe: Does the visual corridor scan say SOUTH can be traversed with engine at least 3 and guidance at least 2?
facts.capacity: Does the manifest establish six travelers and a shuttle capacity of six, so everyone fits?
facts.north_window: Does current navigation data say the north route arrives at 22:06, before the 22:10 deadline?
facts.south_window: Does current navigation data say the south route arrives at 22:08 with engine 3, before the 22:10 deadline?

summary.zh: 不同通道要求不同设备配额。
summary.en: Each corridor requires a different power allocation.

body.zh: 查看北、南通道的最低能源要求；当前扫描有效至 22:10。
body.en: Read the minimum power requirements for north and south. The current scan is valid until 22:10.

summary.zh: 不要遗漏救援艇的承载上限。
summary.en: Check the shuttle's capacity.

body.zh: 等待撤离旅客六人，救援艇核定座位六个。所有人可一次登艇。
body.en: Six travelers await evacuation and the shuttle has six certified seats. Everyone can board on one trip.

summary.zh: 北线较快，但穿过碎片区。
summary.en: Faster, through a debris field.

body.zh: 当前导航解算：北线在护盾 3、引导 2 的配置下于 22:06 到达，早于 22:10 截止时间。
body.en: Current north navigation: with shield 3 and guidance 2, arrival is 22:06, before the 22:10 deadline.

summary.zh: 逆流需要增加引擎输出。
summary.en: The current requires extra engine power.

body.zh: 当前导航解算：南线在引擎 3、引导 2 的配置下于 22:08 到达，早于 22:10 截止时间。
body.en: Current south navigation: with engine 3 and guidance 2, arrival is 22:08, before the 22:10 deadline.

summary.zh: 旧地图显示两条通道都畅通。
summary.en: An older map shows both corridors clear.

body.zh: 地图绘于上周，未包含本次碎片带和逆流。不能说明当前通道安全。
body.en: The map was drawn last week and omits the present debris and current. It does not establish current safety.

summary.zh: 宣传语写着“全天候救援”。
summary.en: The brochure promises all-weather rescue.

body.zh: 宣传资料没有提供当前设备配额、时间窗或核定座位。
body.en: The brochure gives no current power allocation, arrival window or certified seat count.

label.en: Beat the south current with power
Wait for all risk to disappear
